features.name: Bite
features.description: You can use your bite to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: You can breathe air and water, and have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

features.name: Hungry Jaws
features.description: As a bonus action, you can make a special attack with your Bite. On a hit, it deals its normal damage and you gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Natural Armor
features.description: When you aren't wearing armor, your base AC equals 11 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier. The Dexterity modifier added to this AC can't exceed +5. You can use this AC if armor you wear would give you a lower AC, and you can still gain the benefit of a shield.
